title: Nvidia stock drops after spy investigation announced

slides.headline: Nvidia stock drops after spy investigation announced
slides.subtitle: Shares fell more than eight percent on Monday.

slides.explanation: An eight percent drop in value is significant for a company of Nvidia's size, effectively wiping billions of dollars off its market valuation in hours.

slides.headline: The investigation focuses on alleged Chinese intelligence targeting
slides.explanation: The board launched an inquiry specifically into CEO Jensen Huang after reports surfaced that he was a target of Chinese intelligence operations.
Eight independent news outlets including the BBC and The Verge have verified these reports, confirming the investigation is officially underway.

caption:
Nvidia stock took a hit early Monday morning following a major announcement from the company's board.

Directors have launched a formal investigation into CEO Jensen Huang.

This move comes after reports suggested he was being targeted by intelligence operations from China.

Investors reacted quickly to the news, pushing the share price down by over eight percent during the opening hours of trading.

story.title: Nvidia shares tumble after spy probe announced
story.summary: Shares of artificial intelligence leader Nvidia tumbled early Monday after the chip company said it launched an investigation of CEO Jensen Huang following reports he was targeted by Chinese intelligence. Nvidia shares were down more than eight percent in opening trading after its board announced that a committee of independent directors assisted by outside counsel would undertake the probe.
